IMPERIAL AIRLINES
EMBRAER EMB-110P1 BANDEIRANTE
EMERGENCY PROCEDURES
(PLEASE DO NOT REMOVE THIS CARD FROM AIRCRAFT)
WHERE TO FIND YOUR LIFE VEST
Life vests are located in a holder under
each seat. Do not remove the life vest from
the sealed bag unless actually necessary.
HOW TO USE YOUR LIFE VEST
A Put on life vest over head.
B Wrap straps around waist and tie in front.
C AFTER YOU LEAVE AIRCRAFT, jerk gas
release knobs.
D If later the vest becomes too soft, it may
be inflated orally.
WHAT TO DO IN CASE OF AN EMERGENCY LANDING
Remain calm and follow instructions of crew. Sit well
back in seat - pull seat belt tight - assume appropriate
position in illustration until plane stops. When airplane is

PLEASE OBSERVE
"NO SMOKING" SIGN
It is an Imperial policy to
request that all passengers
refrain from smoking aboard
the aircraft. We thank you for
your cooperation in this matter.
PLEASE FASTEN
SEAT BELTS BEFORE
TAKEOFF AND LANDING
At takeoff and landing, seat
belts should be fastened. At
these times, the "Fasten Seat
Belt" sign will be lighted. In
bumpy air, the sign will be
lighted during flight. There is
no cause for alarm but we ask
that you comply for a more
comfortable ride. When the
sign is off, your belt may be
released.
HOW TO USE FIRE EXTINGUISHER
